This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   The user wants the Size Chart page (both list page and editor page) built to full completion - production-grade, competitor-beating quality. Specifically:
   - Match the dashboard's custom card-based design language (NOT plain Polaris boxes)
   - Reference competitor screenshots shared earlier (Shopplaza, Mageplaza, Kiwi Sizing, SmartSize, Shopilaza template editor)
   - Deploy ALL agents and keep assigning until the entire page is done end-to-end
   - Include all sub-components and sub-pages
   - Only stop when 100% complete

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - React Router 7 (NOT Remix) — imports from `react-router`, never `@remix-run/*`
   - Shopify Polaris web components (`<s-page>`, `<s-section>`, `<s-button>`, `<s-badge>`, etc.)
   - App Bridge v4 (`useAppBridge()`) for toasts
   - Prisma v6 with SQLite (dev), scoped to `session.shop`
   - TypeScript strict mode — zero `any`
   - Custom inline styles matching dashboard design language (cardStyle, badgeStyle, sectionTitle)
   - Multi-agent parallel execution via Claude Agent SDK
   - Git post-commit auto-push hook
   - Three-tab editor layout (Size Chart | Assignments | Settings)
   - Template picker grouped by category with emoji icons
   - Live preview sidebar (dark header, status dot, unit tabs, realistic widget mockup)

3. Files and Code Sections:
   - **`app/routes/app.size-charts.tsx`** (1096 lines) — Size Charts list page, last rebuilt
     - Template picker grouped by category: Tops (👕), Bottoms (👖), Dresses (👗), Shoes (👟), Kids (🧒), Rings (💍), Sportswear (🏃), General (📏)
     - Search bar with icon for filtering by name
     - Status pill tabs (All/Active/Draft with counts)
     - Category dropdown filter
     - Chart rows with custom badges, assignment count, dates
     - Empty state centered with icon and CTA
     - Sidebar: progress bar for chart limits, plan badge
     - Key style constants: `cardStyle`, `sectionTitle`, `badgeStyle()`, `CATEGORY_ICONS`

   - **`app/routes/app.size-charts.$id.tsx`** (1850 lines) — Size Chart Editor, last rebuilt
     - Three-tab layout: "Size Chart" | "Assignments" | "Settings" with `useState<"chart"|"assignments"|"settings">`
     - TableEditor: pill unit toggles, uppercase headers, inset focus highlight on cells, hover-to-reveal red delete buttons
     - ChartPreview: dark `#1a1a1a` header, status dot (green=live/gray=draft), unit tab strip, realistic storefront widget mockup with shadow
     - Settings tab: "How to Measure" guide (Chest/Waist/Hips/Inseam instructions), red-tinted Danger Zone card
     - Assignments tab: type badge list, add form, info banner for new charts

   - **`app/routes/app._index.tsx`** (756 lines) — Dashboard (reverted to richer design)
     - Stat cards using `grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr)` (fixed 4th card wrap bug)
     - Setup guide: collapsible, progress bar, expandable steps with `<s-button>` toggle
     - Custom `cardStyle`, `badgeStyle`, `sectionTitle` constants — THIS is the design language to match
     - Emoji icons in CTA banner (📏) and recent charts empty state (📐)

   - **`app/routes/app.widget.tsx`** (982 lines) — Widget Customizer
     - Single save button in `slot="primary-action"` 
     - Text fields grouped in one `<s-box>` card
     - Real-time preview sidebar

   - **`.claude/commands/build.md`** — New `/build` slash command (6-phase pipeline)
   - **`.claude/agents/builder.md`** — Updated to `model: opus`
   - **`.claude/agents/quality-gate.md`** — Updated to `model: opus`
   - **`.git/hooks/post-commit`** — Auto-push to GitHub after every commit
   - **`shopify.app.toml`** — `scopes = "write_products"` (fixed dev preview error)

4. Errors and fixes:
   - **"Failed to start dev preview"**: Fixed by adding `scopes = "write_products"` to `shopify.app.toml` line 27. The `[product.metafields]` section required this scope.
   - **"Example Domain" shown in browser**: App must be opened through Shopify admin tunnel URL (press `p` in terminal or use the preview URL), not directly.
   - **4th stat card wrapping to new row**: Fixed by changing stats container from `display: flex; flexWrap: wrap` to `display: grid; gridTemplateColumns: repeat(4, 1fr)`.
   - **`variant="secondary"` invalid on `<s-button>`**: Fixed to `variant="tertiary"`. Valid variants are only `primary`, `tertiary`, `plain`.
   - **`<s-button size="small">` error**: Removed `size` prop — not supported on Polaris web component button.
   - **`<s-link style={...}>` error**: Removed `style` prop — not supported on `<s-link>`.
   - **Multiple TypeScript errors after rebuilds**: All agents run `npx tsc --noEmit` and fix errors before completing.
   - **User reverted dashboard redesign**: When agents replaced custom card styles with plain Polaris `<s-box>`, result looked too plain. Reverted to commit `91cc672` (the custom card design with emoji icons) and only fixed the grid layout bug.

5. Problem Solving:
   - Established a consistent design language across all pages (cardStyle, sectionTitle, badgeStyle constants)
   - Built parallel agent execution for speed (3 agents at once for Dashboard + Size Charts + Widget)
   - Git post-commit hook auto-pushes to `boldteq/Size-Chart---Recommender` on every commit
   - Created `/build` slash command for end-to-end automated page building
   - Saved design language preference to Claude memory so future sessions stay consistent

   - **CURRENT PRIMARY TASK**: Complete the Size Chart pages end-to-end to production-grade quality
     - Both `app.size-charts.tsx` (list) and `app.size-charts.$id.tsx` (editor) need to be fully polished
     - Must match dashboard design language (cardStyle, badgeStyle, custom cards with icons)
     - Must incorporate features from competitor screenshots: measurement guide, template categories with photos/icons, import modal, tabs (Size chart/Position/Recommendation), position settings, unit conversion toggle
     - Deploy all agents and keep iterating until 100% done
   - Remaining pages to build eventually: Analytics, Pricing (billing integration), Recommender (AI features), Settings

8. Current Work:
   The last completed work was rebuilding both size chart pages with parallel agents:
   - **List page** (`app.size-charts.tsx`): Template picker grouped by emoji category, search bar, pill filter tabs (All/Active/Draft with counts), chart rows with custom badges
   - **Editor page** (`app.size-charts.$id.tsx`): Three-tab layout (Size Chart|Assignments|Settings), polished table editor, live preview sidebar with dark header

// This is your Prisma schema file,
// learn more about it in the docs: https://pris.ly/d/prisma-schema

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

// Note that some adapters may set a maximum length for the String type by default, please ensure your strings are long
// enough when changing adapters.
// See https://www.prisma.io/docs/orm/reference/prisma-schema-reference#string for more information
datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = "file:dev.sqlite"
}

model Session {
  id            String    @id
  shop          String
  state         String
  isOnline      Boolean   @default(false)
  scope         String?
  expires       DateTime?
  accessToken   String
  userId        BigInt?
  firstName     String?
  lastName      String?
  email         String?
  accountOwner  Boolean   @default(false)
  locale        String?
  collaborator  Boolean?  @default(false)
  emailVerified Boolean?  @default(false)
  refreshToken        String?
  refreshTokenExpires DateTime?
}

model SizeChart {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop      String
  name      String
  type      String   @default("table") // table, visual, image
  category  String   @default("general") // tops, bottoms, dresses, shoes, kids, rings, sportswear, general
  data      String   @default("{}") // JSON: { headers, units, rows }
  isDefault Boolean  @default(false)
  status    String   @default("active") // active, draft, archived
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  assignments ChartAssignment[]

  @@unique([shop, name])
  @@index([shop])
  @@index([shop, status])
}

model ChartAssignment {
  id              String @id @default(cuid())
  shop            String
  sizeChartId     String
  assignmentType  String // product, collection, tag, product_type, all
  assignmentValue String // product ID, collection ID, tag name, product type name, or "*"

  sizeChart SizeChart @relation(fields: [sizeChartId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([shop, sizeChartId, assignmentType, assignmentValue])
  @@index([shop, assignmentType, assignmentValue])
}

model SizeChartTemplate {
  id       String  @id @default(cuid())
  name     String
  category String  // tops, bottoms, dresses, shoes, kids, rings, sportswear
  gender   String  @default("unisex") // male, female, unisex
  data     String  @default("{}") // JSON: { headers, units, rows }
  isSystem Boolean @default(true)
}

model RecommenderConfig {
  id          String  @id @default(cuid())
  shop        String  @unique
  enabled     Boolean @default(false)
  algorithm   String  @default("basic") // basic, advanced
  bodyTypes   String  @default("[]") // JSON array of enabled body types
  sizingRules String  @default("{}") // JSON custom sizing rules
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt
}

model WidgetConfig {
  id              String @id @default(cuid())
  shop            String @unique
  displayMode     String @default("popup") // popup, inline, both
  position        String @default("bottom-right") // bottom-right, bottom-left, top-right, top-left
  triggerType     String @default("button") // button, link, tab
  primaryColor    String @default("#000000")
  successColor    String @default("#16a34a")
  errorColor      String @default("#dc2626")
  backgroundColor String @default("#ffffff")
  textColor       String @default("#111111")
  borderRadius    String @default("8")
  heading         String @default("Size Guide")
  placeholder     String @default("Select your size")
  buttonText      String @default("Find My Size")
  successMessage  String @default("This size should fit you well!")
  errorMessage    String @default("We couldn't determine your size. Please refer to the chart.")
  showRecommender Boolean @default(true)
  customCss       String @default("")
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt
}

model AnalyticsEvent {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop        String
  sizeChartId String?
  eventType   String   // view, click, recommend, convert, dismiss
  productId   String?
  metadata    String   @default("{}") // JSON: extra data
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([shop, createdAt])
  @@index([shop, sizeChartId])
  @@index([shop, eventType])
}

model Subscription {
  id                      String    @id @default(cuid())
  shop                    String    @unique
  planId                  String    @default("free") // free, starter, growth, pro
  billingInterval         String    @default("monthly") // monthly, annual
  shopifySubscriptionId   String?
  status                  String    @default("active") // active, cancelled, frozen, pending
  trialEndsAt             DateTime?
  createdAt               DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt               DateTime  @updatedAt
}
